item.title: Ky-Mani Marley & Charleston’s Livity Foundation Present $40,000 Check to Water Mission for Clean Water Systems in Jamaica
item.description: Local leaders, nonprofit partners, and international guests will gather Friday, Dec. 5, for a check presentation celebrating $40,000 raised by the Charleston community to support emergency clean water efforts in Falmouth, Jamaica.

item.title: Drawing Near to God Offers a Welcoming Space During a Stressful Season
item.description: The holiday season is a joyful time for many, but a challenging and lonely one for others. Drawing Near to God (DNG) wants women to feel supported in the new year and is excited to offer resources to do so.

item.title: Modus21, LLC expands Charleston County operations
item.description: Modus21, LLC (Modus21), a business technology consulting firm, today announced it is expanding its operations in Charleston County. The company’s $1.1 million investment will create 80 new jobs.

item.title: Kids Teeth Launches 2025 Holiday Drive to Support Children and Windwood Family Services
item.description: Kids Teeth is continuing its holiday tradition of giving back by launching the 2025 donation drive in support of Windwood Family Services.

item.title: Celebrate Christmas in Charleston at The Palmetto Hotel
item.description: The Palmetto Hotel is coming alive with festive programming and holiday spirit this December.

item.title: Ruby Sunshine Debuts Cozy Winter Menu Full of Holiday Cheer
item.description: Ruby Sunshine is welcoming the holiday season with open arms – and a table full of comforting, winter-inspired dishes and drinks. The beloved spot for everyday breakfast, brunch and lunch is rolling out its new winter menu

item.title: Bank Of America's "Museums On Us" Program Offering Free Admission to IAAM and Gibbes Museums This Weekend
item.description: Bank of America, Merrill, and Bank of America Private Bank cardholders can receive free general admission to two of Charleston’s cultural attractions - The International African American Museum (IAAM) and Gibbes Museum of Art this weekend

item.title: Silent Auction at Beeple Studios Supports Public Works Art Center and their Expansion
item.description: Beeple Studios will host a silent art auction during Charleston Art Night on Dec. 13 from 7 p.m. to midnight at 2325 Charleston Regional Pkwy.

item.title: Ruby Sunshine Charleston Launches New $10 College Student Breakfast Deal
item.description: Ruby Sunshine in Charleston is introducing a new weekday promotion designed to fuel busy students across the Holy City. Beginning Dec. 1, any college student with a valid student ID can enjoy an exclusive $10 breakfast sandwich meal deal
